cards.title: 10 bilesenin hepsi yaziliyor - 15 ajan calisiyor
cards.body: Faz 1 Contracts - FollowData, CommentData, NotificationData, MessageData (E2EE), BlockData, ReportData + event adlari + alt navigasyon (Wall, Search, Messages, Alerts, Profile) Faz 2 Services - FollowService, FeedService, CommentService, NotificationService, SearchService, ModerationService, MessageService Faz 3 Components - PostCard, PostComposer, PersonRow, FollowButton, AvatarBubble, AddressChip, CommentRow, MessageBubble, EmptyState Faz 4 Pages - Welcome, Wall, Profile, PostThread, Search, Alerts, Messages, Settings Faz 5 Wiring - host baslangici, _Imports, MainLayout Faz 6 Build - derle, hatalari duzelt, dogrula Sonuc geldiginde uygulamayi ayaga kaldirip tarayicida acacagim.
